projects.name: SQL Data Warehouse
projects.description: Built an enterprise Medallion Data Warehouse consolidating 116K+ ERP/CRM records with high-performance ETL pipelines.
bullet_points: Built an enterprise Medallion Data Warehouse consolidating 116K+ ERP/CRM records in <3s via T-SQL BULK INSERT with TABLOCK and SSIS staging workflows.
Cut analytical query latency by 70–80% (from ~5s to <0.8s) by architecting a Gold Star Schema with integer surrogate keys replacing a 6-table join graph.
Delivered aggregated RFM customer and product data marts governing $29.4M in revenue across 27.6K orders using windowed queries and automated deduplication.

projects.name: Crypto Market Data Lake
projects.description: Automated ingestion and analytics pipeline for cryptocurrency market data with real‑time visual dashboards.
bullet_points: Automated micro-batch ingestion for 3 crypto assets at <1.2s latency using hourly Python scripts extracting CoinGecko REST APIs into AWS S3.
Enabled zero-copy schema-on-read processing in Snowflake via S3 external stages and automated COPY INTO pipelines, eliminating transformation bottlenecks.
Built a real-time Streamlit and Plotly analytics dashboard visualizing 24h price deltas via SQL LAG() and 6‑hour moving averages across 500 records.

projects.name: TaskFlow: AI Vector Indexing & Data Pipeline
projects.description: Vector indexing and semantic deduplication pipeline with multi‑tenant support and fast query performance.
bullet_points: Engineered a vector indexing pipeline using ChromaDB, achieving 6.60ms Top‑5 retrieval and strict multi‑tenant partition filtering across task embeddings.
Designed relational schemas in SQLite via SQLAlchemy, indexing foreign keys to achieve 0.62ms read queries and executing automated versioned migrations via Alembic.
Built an automated semantic deduplication pipeline using cosine similarity scoring, reaching 92–96% semantic accuracy and 100% exact match precision at 8–16ms latency.
